rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Rust-based Linux system administration server that provides over 100 tools across 15 domains including system info and control, process management, systemd service control, journald log access, network configuration, file operations with path restrictions, Docker container management, package management (apt/dnf/pacman), user/group identity, disk and SMART monitoring, crontab scheduling, security auditing, hardware enumeration, desktop integration (notifications, clipboard, media), and NTP time synchronization. Runs over stdio and is designed to operate behind the neurond federation proxy for authentication and policy enforcement. Includes input validation, shell metacharacter rejection, and path allowlisting for security.
